name: AIGE Carousel Studio
original_description:
AIGE Carousel Studio is an AI carousel maker for Instagram and LinkedIn. Paste an article, blog post, thread, newsletter or a rough idea and get a saved, editable carousel: slide-by-slide copy, on-brand design and image files you can post yourself.

Ask for things like:
- "Turn this article into a carousel."
- "Make an Instagram carousel about our product launch."
- "Create a LinkedIn carousel with my brand colors."
- "Rewrite slide 3 with a shorter headline."
- "Export the slides."

What it does:
- Plans the carousel from your text and works to preserve your facts. Review the copy before you post.
- Writes a headline and body copy for each slide.
- Uses your saved AIGE brand colors and fonts, or the ones you give it.
- Shows slide previews in chat and saves the deck to AIGE Canvas for more editing.
- Checks a deck before you post: placeholder text, low contrast, and text that does not fit, overlaps or is too small to read.
- Lets you fine-tune by hand in the panel: a slide's words and text size, and every part of a drawn background.
- Can put an image you attach in the chat on the slides.
- Prints your handle with your profile picture beside it, from an account you connected in AIGE, a picture you attach or a direct image link, on every slide or only the ones you tick.
- Lays stickers on slides, such as a cut-out, a logo or a product shot, that you can move, size, turn or remove by hand in the panel.
- Exports full-resolution PNG or JPG files, with a Download button in the panel, and saves reusable templates.

Good to know:
- An AIGE account connection is required.
- Optional slide illustration uses your existing AIGE account entitlements, only for the slides you select and within the credit limit you set.
- Server previews and exports can differ from the in-browser layout; warnings say when.
- Exported files are served from public links: anyone who has a link can open that file.
- It does not post to Instagram or LinkedIn, and it does not export PDF or PowerPoint files.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram or LinkedIn.
